visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot features a person's hands holding a clear glass bowl filled with bright red, peeled cherry tomatoes. In the blurred background, a modern kitchen setting with white surfaces and two glass bottles of balsamic vinegar is visible under bright, natural daylight. The person's fingers are visible as they gently rotate the bowl to showcase the glossy texture of the fruit. (2) The scene shifts as one hand pours a golden-yellow liquid from a glass bottle labeled 'Terra del Tuono' into the bowl of tomatoes. The liquid splashes gently against the tomatoes, gradually filling the container. The lighting highlights the transparency of the vinegar and the smooth skin of the tomatoes as they become submerged. (3) A stream of thick, translucent honey is drizzled over the tomatoes from above. Subsequently, a pair of long metal tweezers is used to carefully place three large, green, jagged-edged perilla leaves on top of the mixture. The hands move with precision, ensuring the leaves are tucked into the liquid. (4) A white circular plastic lid is pressed onto the glass bowl, creating a seal. The hands then lift the entire container, tilting it slightly towards the camera to show the final composition of red tomatoes, green leaves, and clear pickling liquid before the video ends in the same kitchen environment.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 超級簡單的又健康的『醋漬番茄』. [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. (2) [Subtitle]: 將番茄去好皮. (3) [Subtitle]: 使用天然釀造的白巴薩米克醋或者蘋果醋. (4) [Subtitle]: 沒有化學成分 沒有額外添加糖. (5) [Subtitle]: 直接倒入容器裡 大約蓋到番茄即可. (6) [Subtitle]: 同樣的方法，你也可以醃漬洋蔥絲. (7) [Subtitle]: 醋番茄、醋洋蔥 低熱量，幫助消化 穩定血糖、抗氧化. (8) [Subtitle]: 是非常棒的開胃菜喔. (9) [Subtitle]: 加入適量的蜂蜜. (10) [Subtitle]: 可以放一些紫蘇葉增加風味！ (11) [Subtitle]: 不放也是可以的！ (12) [Subtitle]: 將紫蘇葉稍微浸泡到汁. (13) [Subtitle]: 像這樣就完成囉！有沒有超簡單！ (14) [Subtitle]: 蓋上蓋子，移到冰箱冷藏12小時. (15) [Subtitle]: 沒有任何添加物 沒有額外的糖 最健康的『醋漬番茄』.
